first_time: Explicit human entry, no suggestion default; Unknown must be null; earliest evidence available at or before result observation
independence: Reviewer-specific browser storage; separate people/profiles, no identity authentication claim
agreement: Exact interval/outcome/first frame; disagreements pending, never average; all source opinions retained
training_gate: At least10 approved v2 positive and10 negative intervals across6 sources, train/val split and valid causal window coverage still required
